Home/About
Our story

Why Hope Beyond Diagnosis exists

A brand-new organisation, built from a real family's experience of searching for answers.

The challenge

Many children live for years without a diagnosis. While specialists run tests and families wait for answers, day-to-day life doesn't pause — school still needs navigating, siblings still need attention, and parents still need to sleep, eat, and hold on to some sense of themselves. Support services are often built around a diagnosis code, which can leave undiagnosed families feeling like they don't quite belong anywhere.

Our mission

Hope Beyond Diagnosis exists to make sure no family feels forgotten while they search for answers. We bring together practical resources, honest community, and hope — not a diagnosis, and not medical advice, but the things that make an uncertain journey a little more bearable.

Our vision

We want to grow, slowly and honestly, into one of the places families are pointed to the moment "we don't have an answer yet" enters the conversation — a place that offers something useful on day one, not just sympathy.

Our values

Compassion first

Never clinical, never judgmental — every page is written for a tired parent at the end of a hard day.

Radical honesty

We'd rather say "we're new at this" than pretend to be something we're not. Trust is earned slowly.

Community over isolation

No family should have to feel like they're the only one facing this. We exist to close that gap.

Accessible to everyone

Free resources, plain language, and a site built to work for every family, every device, every ability.

About the founder

Hope Beyond Diagnosis was started by a teenager who watched his own younger sibling's family navigate the uncertainty of an undiagnosed condition. Watching that search for answers up close — and how hard it was to find resources, community and understanding along the way — is what led to building this platform.

Hope Beyond Diagnosis does not provide medical advice, and its founder is not a medical professional. Its purpose is support, education, hope and connection — the things that were hard to find during his own family's journey, offered here so other families don't have to search as hard.

"Every child deserves support, even without a diagnosis."

Home/FAQ
Good questions

Frequently asked questions

Is Hope Beyond Diagnosis a medical organisation?

No. We are not medical providers, and nothing on this site is medical advice. We provide support, education, and community resources meant to complement — never replace — your child's actual care team.

Do you charge for resources?

No. Every resource in the Family Resource Centre is free to download, and we intend to keep it that way.

Can I donate to Hope Beyond Diagnosis?

Not yet. We haven't set up a donation system, and we didn't want to add a Donate button before we could handle funds properly and transparently. This page will be updated the moment that changes.

How do I share my family's story?

Visit the Family Stories page and use the form there — send it by email or WhatsApp, whichever you check more often. You can stay fully anonymous if you'd prefer, and nothing is published without your permission.

Is anything I submit saved automatically?

No — being fully honest, there's no database yet. Every form on this site (contact, volunteer, partner, story, community) opens a pre-filled email or WhatsApp message for you to send. We personally read, save, and act on each one ourselves; nothing sits on a server in between.

How do I join a community group?

Visit the Community page and fill in the short form about your child's age and needs. We'll suggest the group that fits, and you can request to join over WhatsApp or email — a real person reviews every request before adding anyone.

My child doesn't have a diagnosis at all — is this still for us?

Yes — this organisation exists specifically for families in exactly that position. Many of our resources are written with the undiagnosed journey in mind.

How can my organisation partner with you?

Visit the Partners page and use the enquiry form there. We're brand new and don't have any formal partnerships yet, so early conversations genuinely shape what this becomes.

Home/Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 2026

Hope Beyond Diagnosis ("we", "us") is a newly-founded organisation supporting families of children with undiagnosed conditions and disabilities. This policy explains, plainly, what happens with information you share with us.

What we currently collect

At this stage of the website, we do not operate user accounts, and forms on this site (contact, volunteer, partner, and story submissions) open your own email application rather than submitting data to a server we control. If you subscribe to our newsletter, we collect your email address in order to send occasional updates.

What we don't do

  • We do not sell, rent, or trade your information to anyone.
  • We do not use tracking advertising cookies.
  • We do not currently process payments or donations of any kind.

Family stories

Stories submitted for publication are reviewed by us before anything is published, and are never published without the submitter's explicit permission. You may request anonymity, and you may request removal of a published story at any time by contacting us.

Children's information

We ask for very limited information about children (such as an optional age range) only where a parent or guardian chooses to share it, and only for the purpose of context in a story or resource request. We do not knowingly collect information directly from children.

Future features

As this platform grows to include accounts, a community space, and other features, this policy will be updated to reflect exactly what data is collected, how it's stored, and how it's protected — before those features launch, not after.

Contact us

Questions about this policy can be sent to Hopebeyonddiagnosis@gmail.com.

Home/Terms of Use

Terms of Use

Last updated: July 2026

Not medical advice

Hope Beyond Diagnosis is not a medical provider. Nothing on this website — including downloadable resources, articles, or community content — constitutes medical, legal, or financial advice. Always consult qualified professionals regarding your child's specific situation.

Free resources

Resources in the Family Resource Centre are free to download and print for personal, family, or classroom use. Please don't resell them or present them as your own work.

Community conduct (future feature)

When community features open, all members will be expected to follow published community guidelines centred on kindness, honesty, and safety — particularly given that this community exists to support families of children with disabilities and undiagnosed conditions. Harassment, medical misinformation, and solicitation will not be tolerated, and reported content will be reviewed by an administrator.

No donations accepted currently

This site does not currently process donations of any kind. Any communication claiming to collect donations on behalf of Hope Beyond Diagnosis should be treated as fraudulent and reported to us immediately.

Changes to these terms

As the platform grows, these terms will be updated, particularly once accounts, community features, and donations are introduced.

Contact

Questions can be sent to Hopebeyonddiagnosis@gmail.com.
